mass.name: Friday of the Fourth Week of Lent

preface.locus: Missale Romanum 1962, registered CMAA facsimile; printed p. 116; PDF physical p. 197; unnumbered Praefatio de Quadragesima appointment following Secreta; preface body is referred to, not printed within this formulary; expected-target row roman-1962:temporal:slot:feria-6-post-dominicam-4-in-quadragesima:preface

ordinary_frame.basis: This remains a Mass. The normal formulary appoints Oratio super populum after Postcommunion and before dismissal (Missale Romanum 1962, printed p. 116, numbered text 742; artifact PDF p. 197). The held generic Ordinary frame has no declared place for this prayer, so that frame is unavailable. The Propers remain in their printed order.

provenance.provenance_authority: Triptych editorial projection verified by page-image collation against the 1962 target edition
provenance.provenance_evidence: The project-owned projection passage reproduces the retained calendar body hash exactly. Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: 1862 text layer damages 5 place(s) in this prayer; at each the 1962 word and the layer's reading are: mundum -> mun dum; sacramentis presta -> sacramen tis prasta; eternis proficiat -> etsrnis profi ciat; temporalibus -> tempor li bus; destituatur -> destitudtur; 1922 Mame text layer damages 3 place(s) here (chiefly its OCR of the ae/oe ligatures and of the acute accents): deus -> eius annuntiat firmamentum gloria patri oratio de; presta quesumus -> preesta qusumus; eternis -> zternis; both antecedents print the ae and oe ligatures and the printed acute accents, and use the j-orthography; this transcription follows the repository convention recorded in src/sources/calendars/roman-1962/propers.yaml (j retained, ae/oe digraphs written as two letters, no accent marks). Corroboration: 1922 Mame, editio quarta iuxta typicam Vaticanam (public domain), printed p. 144, artifact PDF p. 258; Benziger 1962 conformed printing OCR at djvu text line 32914 (comparison witness only, rights_status unresolved; never a publication basis); the 1604 and 1570 were not consulted for this oration - the 1862 and the 1922 Mame between them read the whole prayer.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui ineffabilibus mundum renovas sacramentis: praesta, quaesumus; ut
Ecclesia tua et aeternis proficiat institutis, et temporalibus non
destituatur auxiliis. Per Dominum.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Munera nos, Domine, quaesumus, oblata purificent: et te nobis jugiter
faciant esse placatum. Per Dominum.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Haec nos, quaesumus, Domine, participatio sacramenti: et a propriis reatibus
indesinenter expediat, et ab omnibus tueatur adversis. Per Dominum.
